rationale: The construction is internally consistent and the sign follows naturally, but it is essentially the union of two archived deleveraging signals (rent-gated and reinvestment-gated) whose legs are themselves close relatives of the gross-profitability and debt-financing anomalies, so the incremental information content is modest.

This is a cosmetic augmentation of the archive's best signal (Research Duration Mismatch) that merely adds a positive-part R&D-change term of a completely different scale (delta-xrd/lag-assets versus xrd/sale) to the existing MA leg, so any change in performance will be an uninterpretable artifact of relative unit magnitudes rather than a test of the stated horizon-lengthening mechanism.

Swapping sstk for sstk-prstkc in the archived Equity Issuance Research Transience signal is a one-token variant, and because the second leg is a strictly non-negative magnitude modulator the signal reduces to the well-known net share issuance anomaly reweighted by intangible-spending noise, making the "transience" mechanism untestable separately from issuance itself.

The expected sign has been reversed relative to the archived dividend-plus-intangible-expansion signal purely because that signal's alpha came out negative, and the "funding strain" story is a post-hoc rationalization attached to a near-identical construction — this is sign-fitting, not a new mechanism.

Cumulative three-year net debt retirement conditioned on sustained R&D intensity is a genuinely distinct construction from the archived one-period and rent-gated deleveraging variants, the lifecycle-graduation mechanism is coherent, and the flow-based measure sensibly avoids the asset-growth contamination of balance-sheet debt changes — though the non-negative R&D weight means the signal collapses to zero for non-R&D firms and the deleveraging leg alone is a known anomaly.

The conjunction is internally consistent (both legs rise with the unfavorable state, matching the negative expected sign) and pairs the two archived mechanisms with the best FMB/alpha agreement, but MIN-of-ranks conjunctions of prior signals were already exercised in this archive and the dominant leg is close to the established net external financing anomaly, so novelty is limited.
